This looks like a CBP ruling on house number plates of base metal. The relevant heading is 8310, "Sign plates, nameplates, address plates and similar plates, numbers, letters and other symbols, of base metal, excluding those of heading 9405." Heading 8310.00.00 is subdivided in the HTSUS as 8310.00.00 with statistical suffixes: 8310.00.0010 (Of iron or steel?), 8310.00.0030 (Of aluminum?), 8310.00.0060 (Other?). Actually I recall 8310.00.00 having suffixes: 8310.00.0030 "Of aluminum," 8310.00.0060 "Other," and perhaps 8310.00.0010 "Of iron or steel." I'm not certain. The description says "sheet metal" without specifying the metal, so the best fit is the "Other" suffix.

Current HTS is 8310.00.00: 10 "Sign plates, nameplates, address plates..." I believe the 10-digit splits are 8310.00.0030 (Of aluminum?) and 8310.00.0060 (Other). I'll go with 8310.00.0060.
